FX-FISHEYE-001.says: The settings as they start: the lens in the middle, its radius a quarter of the diagonal, 4.7 pixels here, convergence 50: the stripes swell out from the middle inside a circle, and the rest is transparent.

FX-FISHEYE-002.says: Size 100, convergence 0: the lens reaches the corners, every pixel covered: the drawing, untouched.

FX-FISHEYE-003.says: Size 50, convergence 0: the drawing cut to the circle, its rim soft to a pixel.

FX-FISHEYE-004.says: Size 100, convergence 100: the whole drawing laid round a ball, the middle grown by half again and the rim squeezed.

FX-FISHEYE-005.says: Size 100, convergence -100: the other way, the middle drawn in and the rim stretched.

FX-FISHEYE-006.says: Size 100, convergence 50: half way to the ball.

FX-FISHEYE-007.says: Size 30 at the left quarter: a small lens over the left stripes, the rest transparent.

FX-FISHEYE-009.says: Size keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: the lens opens from nothing; frame 2 FX-FISHEYE-001.

FX-FISHEYE-010.says: Convergence keyed from -100 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, size 100: frame 0 FX-FISHEYE-005, frame 2 the drawing, frame 4 FX-FISHEYE-004.

FX-FISHEYE-011.says: Centre keyed from 25, 50 at frame 0 to 75, 50 at frame 4: the lens slides across.

FX-FISHEYE-012.says: FX-FISHEYE-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved; nothing grows.

FX-FISHEYE-013.says: Size eased from 0 at frame 0 to 1000 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it would pass 1000 and is held there.

FX-FISHEYE-014.says: Size 1000, convergence 100: a lens ten times the drawing, so only its middle shows here: the drawing grown by about pi / 2 about the centre.

FX-FISHEYE-015.says: Size 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FISHEYE-016.says: Size -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FISHEYE-017.says: Convergence 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FISHEYE-018.says: Convergence -101, below -100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FISHEYE-019.says: Centre at 50, 1001, past ten heights. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FISHEYE-020.says: Convergence keyed to 200 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
